scope: Occlusion-robust vehicle make recognition from video using semantic-part evidence accumulated across time, with branch-first versus frame-first fusion as the main controlled comparison.

interpretation_boundary.allowed: Describe scope representation, convergence, bag stability, and Core/Coverage separation under the already-frozen v2 policy.
interpretation_boundary.forbidden: Do not report temporal recall, exact-paper non-inferiority, accuracy, or future-prediction performance; this bibliography has no viable positive holdout cutoff.
interpretation_boundary.h3_boundary: Adaptive observation or part acquisition remains secondary and exploratory; it is not required evidence for the main H1-H2 scope.

candidate_admission.rule: Title and abstract must explicitly fit at least one frozen evidence group and add a citable method, dataset, evaluation, limitation, or mechanism role.

legacy_group_key_note: The runner currently reads kbs_frozen_evidence_groups; these groups are independently frozen for C5 and do not reuse the KBS definitions.

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: Fine-grained vehicle make, model, or brand recognition in traffic, CCTV, or surveillance settings, including datasets and evaluation protocols that bound the target task.
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: vehicle make model recognition surveillance video fine grained classification dataset

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: Semantic vehicle-part or local-region evidence for fine-grained recognition when views or discriminative parts are missing, partial, or occluded.
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: vehicle recognition semantic parts occlusion part based local feature attention

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: Multi-frame, track-level, or set-level temporal aggregation that preserves complementary, quality-varying, or intermittently missing recognition evidence.
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: video vehicle recognition temporal evidence fusion multi frame set aggregation missing observations

kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.purpose: Vehicle detection, tracking, and identity-association evidence needed to bound end-to-end recognition failures under occlusion and track fragmentation.
kbs_frozen_evidence_groups.query: vehicle video detection tracking data association occlusion recognition pipeline evaluation
